channel.title: ProjectCostKit
channel.description: Free home project calculators and cost guides: paint, flooring, tile, mulch, gravel, concrete, decks, drywall and pricing tools for contractors.

item.title: Roofing Calculator: Squares, Bundles and Underlayment
item.description: Work out roofing squares, bundles, underlayment rolls and drip edge from roof size and pitch, with a worked example and waste guide.

item.title: Baseboard Calculator: How Much Baseboard Do I Need?
item.description: Get the linear feet of baseboard or skirting for one or more rooms, minus doorways, plus how many 8, 12 or 16 ft pieces to buy.

item.title: Concrete Calculator: Cubic Yards and Bags for Slabs and Footings
item.description: Get cubic yards and 40, 60 or 80 lb bags of concrete for a slab, footing or round column, and compare bagged mix with ready-mix delivery.

item.title: Contractor Hourly Rate Calculator: What Should You Charge?
item.description: Work out the hourly rate you need from the pay you want, your business costs, taxes and real billable hours, so your price covers more than wages.

item.title: Contractor Website Checklist: 15 Things That Bring In Calls
item.description: What a painter, plumber or handyman website actually needs to turn visitors into calls: pages, trust signals, speed, Google setup and mistakes to avoid.

item.title: Cost to Build a Deck in 2026: Wood vs Composite
item.description: A new deck costs $30 to $60 per sq ft in 2026. Compare pressure-treated, cedar and composite, and estimate your deck's price with labor and permit.

item.title: Cost to Paint a Room in 2026: Pro Prices vs Doing It Yourself
item.description: What painters charge per room in 2026, what drives the price up, and a calculator that puts a pro range next to your DIY cost.

item.title: Cost to Paint a House Exterior in 2026
item.description: Exterior painting costs $1.50 to $4 per square foot of home in 2026. See prices by house size, what raises them, and check a quote you got.

item.title: Deck Board Calculator: How Many Deck Boards and Screws
item.description: Count deck boards for any deck size, board width and gap, plus how many face screws you need for wood or composite decking.

item.title: Drywall Calculator: Sheets, Screws, Mud and Tape
item.description: Work out how many sheets of drywall a room needs, plus screws, joint compound and tape, for 4 x 8, 4 x 10 or 4 x 12 sheets or metric boards.

item.title: Exterior Paint Calculator: How Much Paint for a House
item.description: Work out how many gallons of exterior paint your house needs, including gable ends, windows, doors and rough siding like stucco or brick.

item.title: Fence Calculator: Posts, Rails, Pickets and Cost
item.description: Count the posts, rails, pickets and bags of concrete for a wood fence, with gates, and get a materials estimate before you buy or call a contractor.

item.title: Flooring Calculator: How Many Boxes of Flooring to Buy
item.description: Measure your room, add the right waste factor and get the number of boxes of laminate, vinyl plank or hardwood to buy, plus the material cost.

item.title: Flooring Waste Factor: How Much Extra Flooring to Buy
item.description: How much extra flooring and tile to order for cuts and mistakes: 5%, 10% or 15%, depending on the room shape, the layout and the material.

item.title: Free Estimate Template for Contractors: Build and Print a Quote
item.description: Fill in your business, client and line items to get a clean printable estimate with tax, deposit and terms. Save it as a PDF, nothing to sign up for.

item.title: Google Business Profile for Contractors: Setup and Rules
item.description: Set up a Google Business Profile as a contractor or service-area business: hiding your address, service areas, categories, reviews and what gets you suspended.

item.title: Gravel Calculator: How Many Tons of Gravel Do I Need?
item.description: Convert your path, patio base or driveway into cubic yards and tons of gravel, crushed stone or pea gravel, with the material cost before delivery.

item.title: Grout Calculator: How Much Grout Do You Need?
item.description: Work out pounds or kilograms of grout and how many bags to buy from your tile size, tile thickness and joint width, using the manufacturer formula.

item.title: How to Price Handyman Jobs: Rates, Minimums and a Job Calculator
item.description: Price handyman jobs with labor, material markup, trip fees and a minimum charge. Includes 2026 handyman rates and flat prices for common jobs.

item.title: How Many Coats of Paint Do You Need? A Room-by-Room Guide
item.description: Two coats is the usual answer, but not always. When one coat is enough, when you need three, and how primer changes the count.
